chapter: Scrapbook: Blue Room acts and the United Fruit ship
title: House of Pleasure speakeasy and a clipping from Dr. Frank Riddick
summary: Allen says Tony Fougerat played with Riddick at a Prohibition-era speakeasy; Riddick shows a clipping sent by a namesake heart specialist.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: This is George Wagner's daughter. Oh, Tony told me he played with you once at a place called the House of Pleasure.
Tulane and Taunty. Yeah. Do you remember that?
Yes, sir. During Prohibition. It was a speakeasy.
You have chorus lines there? Did we?
No, not there. Not there. But we had Flo Show. Oh, I see. Billy Miller and all of them. I don't know. This is... This must... This is hot out of the oven. This is when I...
When you played for the pizza.

When I was with Shakey's. Oh, awesome. Now, this was sent to me by Dr. Frank Riddick, whom I had never met at the time. He's a heart specialist over at... And he found this on a United plane in... Oh, my way up north, up Michigan somewhere on a United Airlines plane. And it tells you somewhere about... Different places in New Orleans that you would find... And what you would find... I think this is the one...
